_note: Prototype library. In production Prerana AI drafts activities from a fixed prompt library and a person reviews each one before teachers see it.

class_tension.title: Two kind things
class_tension.goal: Rebuild warmth after a tense week, without singling anyone out.
steps: Ask everyone to write one kind thing someone in class did this week, no names needed.
Collect the slips in a box and read five aloud.
Ask: what is one small thing we could do for each other tomorrow?
End with a 1-minute quiet breathing round.

class_tension.title: Weather report
class_tension.goal: Give feelings words in a low-pressure way.
steps: Draw five weather symbols on the board: sunny, cloudy, windy, rainy, stormy.
Each student silently picks the one that matches their week, on paper only.
Talk about what helps when the weather inside is stormy.
Remind the class they can message any trusted adult from the tablet.

class_tension.title: Circle of change
class_tension.goal: Surface group friction safely, for example being left out.
steps: Read a two-line story about a child left out of a group chat.
Ask in pairs: how might they feel, and what could a classmate do?
Collect three ideas on the board and agree on one as a class.
Thank the class and do not ask anyone about themselves.
